# Nour Aldeen Tofi

> AI Automation Engineer — n8n, LLM Agents, MCP · Senior Frontend Developer — based in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia. I turn messy manual processes into self-running workflows — and build the interfaces people use on top of them.

I build AI automation systems that turn messy manual processes into clean, self-running workflows — and the interfaces people use on top of them. My spearhead is n8n paired with language models: production workflows that read Arabic and English documents, validate them, catch what does not belong, and push clean structured data into sheets, CRMs, and dashboards. By day I lead frontend development as a Software Engineering Supervisor, with a track record of owning delivery end to end — requirements, tasks, production.

## Projects

- [Smart Scanner](https://receipt.nexleadtech.com) (2026): Arabic-first AI invoice management — from photo to approval, with zero manual data entry.
- DFS Dashboard (2025–2026): A unified CRM and quotation platform that replaced scattered manual processes across every department.
- [GoldenTag](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.leadbridge.golden_tag) (2025): A jewelry store management app shipped to the Google Play Store.
- Business Card Extractor (2026): Photograph a business card, and it lands in your phone's contacts in one tap.
- MCP Search Server (2026): A Model Context Protocol server that lets an AI model query real data instead of only generating text.

## Automation workflows

- Teacher Assistant AI Bot (2025 — present): A natural-language Arabic assistant delivered to a private tutor in Saudi Arabia. The tutor manages students, schedules, cancellations, and dues entirely through chat — the AI agent calls custom CRUD tools under strict business rules rather than guessing.
- Smart Scanner Extraction Pipeline (2026): The production pipeline behind Smart Scanner. Every invoice — photo or PDF — is verified as a real invoice, parsed with GPT-4.1 Vision, validated, deduplicated, and persisted. It reads Arabic, English, and mixed documents, and is tuned for handwritten Arabic invoices and ZATCA e-invoice fields.
- AI Job-Match Pipeline (2026): A scheduled pipeline that runs five daily search queries across LinkedIn, Indeed, and Glassdoor, scores each role's fit from one to ten with a structured-JSON LLM evaluator, and delivers only the high scorers.
- Smart Lead Finder (2025): Automated B2B lead generation across the Saudi and Jordanian markets: multi-query place search, website scraping to extract emails and WhatsApp numbers, prioritisation scoring, and duplicate-safe appends into segmented sheets.
- Lesson Quality Evaluator (2026): A webhook service that transcribes lesson videos with speaker separation and returns structured JSON scoring teacher quality and student engagement.
- CRM Lead Cleaner (2026): Incoming CRM leads arrive scattered — duplicates, malformed emails, missing fields — and cost sales teams hours of manual triage. This pipeline cleans them automatically and reports on what it did.
